messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — I landed a draft for the benchmark/replay harness that tries to standardize TTFT/TPOT measurements and synthetic vs replayed traffic. Ping for review please.

sandeep: Nice. Where's the repo? link to PR?

maria: repo: https://git.redwood/replay/harness (WIP). Goals: apples-to-apples: same model binary, same quant, same GPU driver + kernel selection flags, fixed CPU pinning.

aj: One quick ask: define TPOT precisely. Is it avg ms/token after first token or total generation time divided by tokens?

maria: TPOT = time-per-output-token measured in steady-state. We compute (total_generation_time - TTFT) / num_output_tokens. TTFT = time from request recv to first token emitted. We report both.

ben: Also record goodput vs QPS. Goodput = tokens/sec that passed quality/latency SLOs (i.e., usable outputs). QPS is raw queries/sec submitted.

ota: For KV cache behavior we should include warm/cold runs: replay harness can replay a user session so KV cache gets warm. Also measure cache-hit ratio metric.

maria: Included a small example harness config:
```json
{"mode":"replay","seed":42,"arrival_pattern":"poisson","mean_qps":50,"batcher":{"max_latency_ms":50,"max_batch_size":64}}
```

sandeep: Important to disable adaptive kernel-selection toggles while comparing. Otherwise autotuner will pick different kernels mid-run and mask regressions.

perf-bot: perf/regression detected: +12% p95 token latency after kernel selector update. Job: ci/perf/17583

aj: Ouch. Can we reproduce with the harness by pinning kernel selection to old/new and comparing? Also capture nvprof traces + host-side flamegraphs.

maria: Yes — plan: 1) run synthetic steady-state (no cache) 2) replay warm-cache session 3) capture TTFT/TPOT, p50/p95/p99, goodput; 4) collect kernel histograms and NVTX ranges.

ben: For apples-to-apples: make sure power/clock governors pinned, same container image, same environment variables for cudnn/cublas.

ota: On metrics: compute percentiles over request-level latencies (not token-level) and report token-level TPOT separately. Also produce boxplots and CDFs.

sandeep: I'll run a bisect between kernel revisions and send results in this thread.

maria: Awesome. If you hit a regression, open a perf issue and include harness config and trace tarball. Thanks!

aj: small nit — ensure synthetic traffic generator supports bursts + long tails; many prod workloads are spiky.

maria: Agree. Added 'burst_ratio' and 'think_time_ms' knobs. Will push change later today :thumbsup:
